data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $15.9 million in 2022, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This contrasts with narrative statements indicating a net release of $7.883 million and overall favourable incurred claims development on prior accident years. The strengthening is attributed to inflation, including social inflation, being factored into reserving. Specific prior year events include a $5.0 million loss on the development of the 2018 and 2019 years of account. However, several classes including Property D&F, Marine Hull, Marine Energy, Non-Marine Liability, and Political Risk reportedly benefited from favourable claims development.
